_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Crop Failure#000.src: Wha- You think those oats over there look fine?! Pff. Yeah, right.

Crop Failure#001.src: They were growing pretty slow this year, all my crops, and then some salesman wanders into town with a "Miracle Cure" fertilizer.

Crop Failure#002.src: Just to prove that ridiculous phony Doubiss is a fraud- Here. I see some roots over here. Watch this, and you tell me if this is a "miracle!"

Crop Failure#003.src: Here we go, here comes the big phenomenal growth that he promised me!

Crop Failure#004.src: That Doubiss won't budge for my refund. I spent...so many emeralds...on this tripe! So that's where YOU come in.
Crop Failure#004.dst: Doubiss ни в какую не вернёт деньги. Я потратил… столько изумрудов… на эту дрянь! Тут-то и нужна ТВОЯ помощь.

Crop Failure#005.src: He's in the blue and gray tent by the bank. I don't care how you do it, but get my money back and we'll split it half-and-half, deal?

Crop Failure#006.src: Since he obviously ain't gonna be listenin' to me anytime soon, lemme tell you what the issue is with my fertilizer...

Crop Failure#007.src: All the other farmers are usin' it right now, and look at their fields! Heck, I think the only reason these crops ain't dead is because of my product!

Crop Failure#008.src: Y'know why? Next time ya pass a farm, take a good whiff o' the water, maybe a sip or two if you can manage. It'll be smelly and bitter.
Crop Failure#008.dst: Знаешь почему? Будешь проходить мимо фермы - понюхай воду, а то и глотни, если сможешь. Вонючая и горькая.

Crop Failure#009.src: The crops, when I got here, were lookin' pathetic as ya get. I ain't a gamblin' man, but I'd be willing ta bet something's up with the water here.

Crop Failure#010.src: The smell gets worse the closer ya get to the crypts in town, and while I ain't a native Oluxer, I've heard enough to know the wellspring is in the cave near there.

Crop Failure#011.src: It'll prob'ly be best fer everyone if ya took a looksee. Maybe if ya find some evidence, ya can show that crazy farmer, have 'im quit pesterin' me, eh?

Crop Failure#012.src: The cave is on the little hill, next to the crypt. Careful ya don't go trippin' over a gravestone, now!

Crop Failure#013.src: The buggers stick to the mountain caves. They don't come down this far usually...s'pose there's an exception fer everything.

Crop Failure#014.src: ...mhm, mhm...you went into the well cave...and found...what, slimes?! Why would the SLIMES be there?

Crop Failure#015.src: I wouldn't believe you if you weren't...well, uh...covered in the stuff. But that's definitely rancid.
Crop Failure#015.dst: Не поверил бы, если б не… ну… вся эта дрянь на тебе. Но протухло точно.

Crop Failure#016.src: So...that means that I've been...oh dear lord I'm an idiot.

Crop Failure#017.src: Just...do me a favor and use that money to buy some good soap and wash up. I'm thankful and all, but you stink to high heaven!
Crop Failure#017.dst: Только… сделай одолжение: купи на эти деньги хорошего мыла и отмойся. Я, конечно, благодарен, но воняешь ты до небес!

Crop Failure#018.src: Trinkets for sale! Come buy yourself some cheap trinkets here!

Crop Failure#019.src: Ah, a customer! Welcome to my store of wares and trinkets!

Crop Failure#020.src: Is there anything that sticks out to you? Anything you'd like to purchase?

Crop Failure#021.src: ... The clock? That old piece of j-

Crop Failure#022.src: ... Yes, of course! Truly, this antique clock is very valuable! I'm sure you could find someone who would buy it for a high price!

Crop Failure#023.src: Taking a look at this clock... It's obviously broken. And yet, you can still hear a ticking sound coming from it...

Crop Failure#024.src: I can sell it to you for [{~} Emerald Blocks]. Truly an excellent price for such a... great item.

Crop Failure#025.src: ... Well, you don't have to decide now, of course! Feel free to come back when you've made your decision!

Crop Failure#027.dst: Ррр… этот никчёмный, лживый, жульничающий, вороватый… ааргх!
Crop Failure#027.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#028.src: You! Help me out over here! You aren't doing anything important right now, and this is urgent!
Crop Failure#028.dst: Ты! Помоги-ка мне! Ничем важным ты сейчас не занят, а дело срочное!
Crop Failure#028.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#029.src: I got a few questions for you, see? Question one: D'you think crops are supposed to look like THIS?
Crop Failure#029.dst: У меня к тебе пара вопросов, ясно? Вопрос первый: по-твоему, урожай должен выглядеть ВОТ ТАК?
Crop Failure#029.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#030.src: Look at them. I don't think there's a way for 'em to look any more sorry than this.
Crop Failure#030.dst: Глянь на них. Жальче выглядеть уже просто некуда.
Crop Failure#030.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#031.src: Wha- You think the Oats over there look fine?! Pff. Yeah, right.
Crop Failure#031.dst: Чт… По-твоему, вон те Oats в порядке?! Пфф. Ага, как же.
Crop Failure#031.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#032.src: If that's the case, go grab a scythe and try harvesting those Oats yourself!!
Crop Failure#032.dst: Раз так, бери косу и сам попробуй собрать эти Oats!!
Crop Failure#032.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#033.src: Go on, do it! I dare you! See how good they really are!!
Crop Failure#033.dst: Давай, вперёд! Слабо? Посмотрим, какие они хорошие!!
Crop Failure#033.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#035.src: See? What'd I tell ya? Rotten to the roots! Nothing here is ANY good!!
Crop Failure#035.dst: Видал? Что я говорил? Гниль до корней! Тут ВСЁ никуда не годится!!
Crop Failure#035.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#036.src: They were growing pretty slow this year, all my crops, and then some salesman walks into town with some "MiracleCure" fertilizer.
Crop Failure#036.dst: В этом году весь мой урожай рос медленно, и тут в город приходит торгаш с каким-то удобрением «ЧудоЛек».
Crop Failure#036.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#037.src: I shoulda known it was too good to be true, but he said everyone else tried it too, so I bought some and tried to salvage this mess.
Crop Failure#037.dst: Надо было понять, что это слишком хорошо, но он сказал, что все уже пробовали, вот я и купил, чтоб спасти этот бардак.
Crop Failure#037.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#038.src: And here we are- me out half my savings and my fields as smelly and dead as an actual CORPSE!
Crop Failure#038.dst: И вот итог: полсбережений нет, а поля смердят и мертвы, как настоящий ТРУП!
Crop Failure#038.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#039.src: Just to prove this ridiculous phony Doubiss is a fraud- Here. I see some roots over here. Watch this, and tell me if this is a "miracle!"
Crop Failure#039.dst: Докажу, что этот нелепый Doubiss - мошенник. Вот. Тут есть корни. Смотри и скажи, «чудо» ли это!
Crop Failure#039.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#040.src: Here we go, here comes the big phenomenal growth he promised me!
Crop Failure#040.dst: Ну, вот сейчас начнётся тот чудесный рост, что он мне обещал!
Crop Failure#040.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#041.src: WOW, INCREDIBLE! AMAZING! It's almost like this is actual poison or something!!
Crop Failure#041.dst: ОГО, НЕВЕРОЯТНО! ПОТРЯСАЮЩЕ! Прямо как настоящий яд!!
Crop Failure#041.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#043.src: He's in that blue and gray tent by the bank. I don't care how you do it, but get my money back and we'll split it half-and-half, deal?
Crop Failure#043.dst: Он в сине-серой палатке у банка. Мне всё равно как, но верни мои деньги, и поделим пополам, идёт?
Crop Failure#043.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#044.src: Find Doubiss the salesman in {p} near the bank at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Crop Failure#044.dst: Найди торговца Doubiss в {p} у банка в [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Crop Failure#045.src: Good day to ya! What is it ye be needin' from ol' Doubiss' stock?
Crop Failure#045.dst: Доброго денька! Чего изволишь из запасов старины Doubiss?
Crop Failure#045.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#046.src: Oh. Oh, goodie. That idiot farmer's sendin' ya to get his money back, ain't he? Sweet baby bovine, this is ridiculous...
Crop Failure#046.dst: О. О, чудненько. Этот дурень-фермер прислал тебя вернуть его деньги, так? Коровушки святые, ну и нелепость…
Crop Failure#046.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#047.src: Since he obviously ain't gonna be listenin' to me anytime soon, lemme tell ya what the issue is with my fertilizer...
Crop Failure#047.dst: Раз он меня слушать не станет, дай-ка расскажу, в чём беда с моим удобрением…
Crop Failure#047.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#048.src: Nothing! My fertilizer really does work! He probl'ly exaggerated how good I said it'd work, too! What'd he say, twice, three times the growth? More?
Crop Failure#048.dst: Ни в чём! Удобрение правда работает! Он, небось, и приукрасил, что я обещал! Что он сказал: рост вдвое, втрое? Больше?
Crop Failure#048.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#049.src: All the other farmers are usin' it right now and look at their fields! Heck, the only reason these crops ain't dead is because of my product!
Crop Failure#049.dst: Все прочие фермеры им пользуются, глянь на их поля! Да эти посевы живы только благодаря моему товару!
Crop Failure#049.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#051.src: The crops, when I got here, were lookin' as pathetic as ya get. I ain't a gamblin' man, but I'd be willing ta bet something's up with the water here.
Crop Failure#051.dst: Когда я сюда пришёл, посевы были жальче некуда. Я не игрок, но готов поспорить: с водой тут что-то не так.
Crop Failure#051.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#052.src: The smell gets worse the closer ya get to the crypts in town, and while I ain't a native Oluxer, I've heard enough to know the wellspring is in the cave hear there.
Crop Failure#052.dst: Чем ближе к городским склепам, тем сильнее вонь, и хоть я не местный из Olux, но слыхал, что источник в пещере где-то там.
Crop Failure#052.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#053.src: It'll prob'ly be best fer everyone if ya took a looksee. Maybe if ya find some evidence, ya can show that to the crazy farmer, have 'im quit pesterin' me, eh?
Crop Failure#053.dst: Всем будет лучше, коль ты туда заглянешь. Найдёшь доказательства - покажешь чокнутому фермеру, пусть отстанет от меня, а?
Crop Failure#053.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#054.src: The cave is on a little hill, next to the crypt. Careful ya don't go trippin' over a gravestone, now!
Crop Failure#054.dst: Пещера на холмике, возле склепа. Гляди не споткнись о надгробие!
Crop Failure#054.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#055.src: Search the aquifer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] for the problem with the water.
Crop Failure#055.dst: Обыщи водоносный пласт в [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] и найди, что не так с водой.

Crop Failure#056.src: Oi, bucko! Took my advice, eh? I'd figured I'd join ye, 'n see for myself what was goin' on.
Crop Failure#056.dst: Эй, дружок! Совет-таки мой пригодился? Решил я к тебе присоединиться да глянуть, что тут творится.
Crop Failure#056.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#057.src: And boy am I glad I bring me water in bottles. This stuff's rancid, full a' swamp slimes. No idea why they're here, though.
Crop Failure#057.dst: И ох как я рад, что воду ношу в бутылках. Эта дрянь протухла, полна болотных слизней. Ума не приложу, откуда они.
Crop Failure#057.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#058.src: The buggers stick to mountain caves. They don't come down this far, usually... suppose there's an exception fer everything.
Crop Failure#058.dst: Эти гады сидят в горных пещерах. Так далеко вниз обычно не спускаются… ну, из всего бывают исключения.
Crop Failure#058.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#059.src: 's no wonder that Anast's crops ain't growin'. This is right under his farm! But we got some clear proof now, ain't we?
Crop Failure#059.dst: Неудивительно, что у Anast ничего не растёт. Это прямо под его фермой! Зато теперь у нас есть доказательство, а?
Crop Failure#059.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#060.src: Howzabout ya take care o' this? I ain't a fighter, but if ya mulch these slimes the water oughta clear up, I figure.
Crop Failure#060.dst: Может, займёшься этим? Я не боец, но если покрошишь этих слизней, вода, думаю, очистится.
Crop Failure#060.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#061.src: Kill the slimes in the aquifer and bring back [Polluted Slime] to Anast.
Crop Failure#061.dst: Убей слизней в водоносном пласте и принеси [Загрязнённая слизь] Anast.

Crop Failure#062.src: Pyyyyeww! Yeesh, kid! You smell worse than a pig's sty! What the heck happened to you, where've you been?!
Crop Failure#062.dst: Фууу! Ну и ну, малый! Воняешь хуже свинарника! Что с тобой стряслось, где тебя носило?!
Crop Failure#062.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#063.src: Ugh, eww! I don't want any of this sludge! I demand an explanation, now!!
Crop Failure#063.dst: Фу, гадость! Не нужна мне эта слякоть! Объяснись, живо!!
Crop Failure#063.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#064.src: ...mhm, mhm...you went into the well cave...and found what, slimes?! Why would SLIMES be there?
Crop Failure#064.dst: …ага, ага… ты полез в пещеру у колодца… и нашёл что, слизней?! Откуда там СЛИЗНИ?
Crop Failure#064.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#066.src: So... that means I've been... oh dear lord I'm an idiot.
Crop Failure#066.dst: Выходит… я всё это время… боже правый, я идиот.
Crop Failure#066.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#067.src: I guess I owe you some thanks anyway for trying to clear the sludge out. Suppose this year's harvest is just a bust.
Crop Failure#067.dst: Всё равно спасибо, что пытался вычистить эту слизь. Похоже, урожай в этом году пропал.
Crop Failure#067.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#068.src: Can't sell what little I have, so I figure you can take it, and a bit of cash too, since you basically did an exterminator's job.
Crop Failure#068.dst: Продать то немногое, что есть, не выйдет, так что забирай, и немного денег впридачу - работа у тебя, считай, была дезинсекторская.
Crop Failure#068.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#070.src: Oi, bucko! Took my advice, eh? I figured I'd join ye, 'n see fer myself what was goin' on.
Crop Failure#070.dst: Эй, дружок! Совет-таки мой пригодился? Решил я к тебе присоединиться да глянуть, что тут творится.
